from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> None:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"PATCH_ANCHOR_COUNT:{path}:{count}")
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


engine = Path("scripts/governance_engine.py")
replace_once(
    engine,
    '''    def run() -> tuple[int, str]:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            argv,
            cwd=root,
            text=True,
''',
    '''    def run() -> tuple[int, str]:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
        completed = subprocess.run(
            argv,
            cwd=root,
            env=env,
            text=True,
''',
)

generator = Path("scripts/generate_project_docs.py")
replace_once(
    generator,
    '''def clean(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()
''',
    '''def canonical_generated_bytes(value: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Normalize checkout line endings before deterministic generated-output comparison."""
    return value.replace(b"\\r\\n", b"\\n").replace(b"\\r", b"\\n")


def clean(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()
''',
)
replace_once(
    generator,
    '''        elif facts_output.read_bytes() != expected_facts_bytes:
            facts_stale = True
''',
    '''        elif canonical_generated_bytes(facts_output.read_bytes()) != expected_facts_bytes:
            facts_stale = True
''',
)
replace_once(
    generator,
    '''            elif path.read_bytes() != expected.encode("utf-8"):
                stale.append("docs/" + name)
''',
    '''            elif canonical_generated_bytes(path.read_bytes()) != expected.encode("utf-8"):
                stale.append("docs/" + name)
''',
)

engine_test = Path("scripts/selftest_governance_engine.py")
replace_once(
    engine_test,
    '''        (scripts / "selftest_governance_engine.py").write_text(
            "print('FIXTURE_ENGINE_REGRESSION=PASS')\\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
''',
    '''        (scripts / "fixture_helper.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (scripts / "selftest_governance_engine.py").write_text(
            "import fixture_helper\\nprint('FIXTURE_ENGINE_REGRESSION=PASS')\\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
''',
)

compiler_test = Path("scripts/selftest_project_truth_compiler.py")
replace_once(
    compiler_test,
    '''        overview = root / "docs" / "SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md"

        duplicate = root / "SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md"
''',
    '''        overview = root / "docs" / "SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md"
        facts_file = root / ".workflow" / "generated" / "code_facts.json"
        overview.write_bytes(overview.read_bytes().replace(b"\\n", b"\\r\\n"))
        facts_file.write_bytes(facts_file.read_bytes().replace(b"\\n", b"\\r\\n"))
        crlf_check = run(
            root,
            sys.executable,
            str(tool_root / "validate_project_docs.py"),
            "--root",
            str(root),
        )
        if "PROJECT_DOCS_SYNC=PASS" not in crlf_check:
            raise RuntimeError("generated CRLF checkout did not canonicalize during check")

        duplicate = root / "SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md"
''',
)
replace_once(
    compiler_test,
    '''    print("PROJECT_DOCS_NORMALIZED=PASS")
    print("DOC_READABILITY=PASS")
''',
    '''    print("PROJECT_DOCS_NORMALIZED=PASS")
    print("GENERATED_CRLF_CHECK=PASS")
    print("DOC_READABILITY=PASS")
''',
)

print("SW2_02_PORTABILITY_PATCH=APPLIED")
